create_text_file_shards: create shards from a text file using chunk, round-robin, or sort strategy
build_textshard_iterator: build a TextShard context manager to lazily iterate lines from a text file
write_text_output_batches: write data batches to CSV or TSV files with optional compression via TextOutputConfig
resolve_shard_output_path: resolve the standard output filename for a TextShard given an output file or suffix
merge_shard_outputs: merge multiple shard output files back into a single file in shard index order
